e.title: reinsureR
e.summary: 再保险 R 包（CRAN）：XL/比例再保险的损失计算与定价函数
e.body: reinsureR（R CRAN）是再保险建模 R 包：超额损失（XL）与比例再保险的损失计算、再保险定价相关函数。对 RIAA：再保险计算的 R 工具——与 [[netsimr]]（非寿险函数包，含再保结构）互补、[[gemact]]（Python 再保险包）跨语言对应；再保险课程（[[rim530]]）的实操函数库；配合 [[insurancerating]]（定价）做「定价 + 再保」完整练习；再保险/风险转移方向的入门工具。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：CRAN 确认（再保险 R 包），未实测
e.summary_en: Reinsurance R package (CRAN): XL/proportional reinsurance loss calculations and pricing functions
e.summary_hk: 再保險 R 包（CRAN）：XL/比例再保險的損失計算與定價函數
e.body_en: reinsureR (R CRAN) is a reinsurance-modelling R package: loss calculations for excess-of-loss (XL) and proportional reinsurance, plus reinsurance-pricing functions. For RIAA: R tools for reinsurance calculations — complementing [[netsimr]] (non-life functions incl. reinsurance structures) and the cross-language counterpart of [[gemact]] (Python reinsurance package); a hands-on function library for the reinsurance course ([[rim530]]); with [[insurancerating]] (pricing) run complete pricing + reinsurance exercises; an entry tool for the reinsurance/risk-transfer direction.
e.body_hk: reinsureR（R CRAN）是再保險建模 R 包：超額損失（XL）與比例再保險的損失計算、再保險定價相關函數。對 RIAA：再保險計算的 R 工具——與 [[netsimr]]（非壽險函數包，含再保結構）互補、[[gemact]]（Python 再保險包）跨語言對應；再保險課程（[[rim530]]）的實操函數庫；配合 [[insurancerating]]（定價）做「定價 + 再保」完整練習；再保險/風險轉移方向的入門工具。
